# Review a build's packet and findings `RVB`

[As built](../README.md) › Review a build's packet and findings

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a reviewer read a feature's calls, evidence, objections and work map, decide on findings, dispatch rework, rebuild and record a final verdict, centered on export:Tabs and the gate-2 review routes.
